text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0845 CDT.

CANOLA - C$4.00 to C$5.00 higher on old crop boosted by strong overnight gains in old crop CBOT soybeans in Project A trading. New crop seen C$6.00 to C$8.00 higher following a bullish Statistics Canada planting intentions report. The July WCE futures crush profit margin rose to -8.50 Tuesday from -11.94 Monday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3960 versus the U.S. dollar and but fell against the yen to 90.76.

FLAX - C$3.00 to C$4.00 lower on old crop and C$5.00 to $8.00 down on new crop. StatsCan plantings report showed sharp increase in flaxseed area. Sluggish export demand also weighing on the market. "Right now flax has no friends," one WCE oilseed trader said.

WESTERN BARLEY - steady to C$0.50 higher on old crop, C$1.00 to C$2.00 lower on new crop. Higher CBOT grain calls should support old crop but StatsCan plantings report seen slightly bearish for new crop.
FEED WHEAT - steady to C$0.50 higher aided by firmer CBOT grain calls. Wheat acreage in StatsCan report broadly in line with expectations.
PEAS - US$2.00 to US$3.00 lower with StatsCan plantings data seen as very bearish.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
